entry.correction: An empty steel autopsy table sits in the inner containment chamber under a single overhead surgical lamp casting a cold pool of light, viewed from the observation room through a wide glass partition, heavy hazmat interlock door ajar at the far back wall, FOREGROUND: condensation beading on the interior side of the partition glass, MIDGROUND: poured concrete chamber floor with hairline cracks and a rusted central drain grate, BACKGROUND: the dim interlock corridor beyond the half-open door, cold blue fluorescent tone with one dead-row tube strobing faintly, fine condensation haze hanging at knee level, breath-visible cold pressing against the glass, isolated certainty, oppressive vigilance
